notes: Accuracy: all 25 sampled brands appear on their src pages and the stated claims are supported (0/25 wrong), but 6 of the 25 carry a premium layer resting on seller praise or second-hand reports (Kokido, Pleatco, Rain Bird, Clementi, Bigei, Earthquake); see downgrade_to_listed for the full weak-evidence set. Additions focus on thin sweeps: pressure washers (Kranzle), sprayers (Birchmeier), greenhouse climate kit (Bio Green, Bayliss), covers/fleece (Haxnicks, Harrod Horticultural, Claverton Cloches), water butts (Harcostar), lawn treatment (SISIS), pool water care/pumps/pools (Taylor Technologies, Pentair, Polaris, Intex, Desjoyaux), open cookers/planchas (Eno, Le Marquier, Plancha Tonio, Forge Adour), tandoors (Amfora etc.), Latin America (Uriarte and Puebla talavera, Truper, Tromen, Parrigas), Japan (Noto shichirin makers, Hyponex), Oceania icons (Yates, Seasol, Masport, Rover Mowers), Germany (Neudorff), India (Ugaoo), Africa (Chillington Crocodile), RHS Chelsea 2019 Product of the Year finalists and 2025 tradestand medallists. Retried and still thin: Turkish/Gulf mangal makers (Turkish queries return only retailers/restaurants; no named maker with standing), bonsai wire and display stands (only seller-made wire such as Bonsai Mirai, Eastern Leaf, Adams-McKinney; not added), pool covers (Coverstar only own page, not added), Mexican clay chimineas (none found), Yixing flower pots (Palace Museum documents the Yixing kiln tradition but no current maker named), Korean onggi pots, Gulf barbecue makers. Homonym watch: Rover (cars) vs Rover Mowers; Hunter (wellingtons) vs Hunter Industries; Polaris (snowmobiles) vs Polaris pool cleaners; Zodiac (watches) vs Zodiac pool; Solo (soda) vs Solo sprayers; Gloria (extinguishers) vs Gloria sprayers; Eden/Robinsons/Trojan in other categories vs greenhouse/wheelbarrow makers; Halls and Viking C2 tags on wrong-sense rows; Uriarte also tableware (place under C2 only for planters). Not yet evidenced but likely omissions for a next pass: Mountfield, AL-KO, Sabo, Etesia, Countax, Westwood, Scag, Ferris, Hustler, Grillo (Italy), Pubert, Billy Goat, Scotts/Westland/Levington/Compo/Substral/Espoma, Claber, Melnor, Leborgne, Outils Perrin, Clarington Forge, Herragro/Incolma (Colombian machetes), Jacto (Brazil sprayers; only seller page found), Ofyr and Hofats fire bowls (only retailer/own pages), PK Grills (tests found in excerpts only), AstralPool, Waterco, Davey, Bayrol, HTH, Kasai Grills, Eliet, Jo Beau, Timberwolf, Laski, Spider Farmer, Mars Hydro, AC Infinity, Gavita, Click & Grow, AeroGarden, Gardyn, Canna, BioBizz.
